_comment: Qualifications of University of Bologna copy records whose own fields contradict one another, keyed by record id. giver_note prints in the book panel's copy section next to the catalogue's 'Autore della dedica' heading; drop_givers keeps that heading as evidence but takes the name off the 'Given to Eco' colouring and the givers list. status names the kind of problem (contradicted: the record's claim cannot be true as it stands).

UBO00189116.giver_note: The catalogue names Matilde Serao, one of the three novelists this book is about, as the giver. She died in 1927; the copy is from 1979 and the inscription is dated 25-6-79, so the Matilde who signed it is someone else.
UBO00189116.source: UNIMARC 317 'Autore della dedica: Serao, Matilde' against the record's year (1979) and the inscription's date; Matilde Serao (1856-1927), Treccani, Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani, https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/matilde-serao_(Dizionario-Biografico)/
